notes_list.title: 🛕 Odisha ke Mandir
notes_list.basic_overview:
📍 Konark Sun Temple (Puri) – Black Pagoda; builder: Narasimhadeva I (Ganga dynasty)
📍 Jagannath Temple (Puri) – White Pagoda; meethi dhara/rasgulla (GI tag)
📍 Mukteshwar Temple (Bhubaneswar)
📍 Lingaraj Temple (Bhubaneswar)
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: ODIsha = UDna. Puri ko dhoop me ek jagah rakho to Black Pakoda, isliye UDao (Odisha) → Konark. Jagna (jagte hi) → safedi aati hai → Jagannath = White Pagoda. Mukti milte hi udne lagte ho → Mukteshwar (Odisha). Meethi cheez = khane ki cheez = Puri Jagannath. Surya = 'nar' → Narasimhadeva I.

notes_list.title: ⚫⚪ Black Pagoda vs White Pagoda
notes_list.basic_overview:
⚫ Black Pagoda → Konark Sun Temple, Odisha (SSC me sabse zyada repeat)
⚪ White Pagoda → Jagannath Temple, Puri, Odisha
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Surya ki dhoop me koi bhi rahe → kala PAKODA ban jaata hai → Black Pagoda = Surya Mandir (Konark). Jagna = savera = white → Jagannath White Pagoda. ODIsha = 'oDessi hole' = side ho ja, warna black pakoda ban jaayega.

notes_list.title: 🏗️ Mandir kisne banwaya? (PYQ)
notes_list.basic_overview:
☀️ Konark Sun Temple → Narasimhadeva I (Ganga dynasty)
🛕 Meenakshi Temple (Madurai) → Pandya shasak (Kulasekara Pandya)
🛕 Brihadeeswara (Thanjavur) → Rajaraja Chola I (Chola)
🛕 Dilwara Jain Temple (Mt. Abu) → Chalukya (Solanki) shasak
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Surya (nar) → Narasimha. Meena + KASI (kudaal) = Pandit log kasi nahi chalate → PANDE → Pandya. Brihad-ESHWAR = ishwar ki daya se raja RAJ karta hai → Rajaraja Chola. Dilwara: dil me jise baadte ho wo CHAL ke aata hai → Chalukya.

notes_list.title: 🛕 Jammu & Kashmir ke Mandir
notes_list.basic_overview:
📍 Raghunath Temple (Jammu) – Bhagwan Ram ko samarpit
📍 Vaishno Devi (Katra)
📍 Amarnath Cave Temple
📍 Martand Sun Temple (Anantnag)
📍 Kheer Bhawani Temple (+ Mela Kheer Bhawani)
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Raghunath = Ram (Raghukul); J&K map ka taaj → Ram ko taaj → Raghunath. Vaishno = VESH badal ke aatankwadi ghuste hain. Amarnath = jahan sabse zyada fight, wahan sabse zyada 'amar' (shaheed). Martand = MARna/MAAR-kaat. Kheer = barf ka rang kheer jaisa safed.

notes_list.title: 🛕 Gujarat ke Mandir
notes_list.basic_overview:
📍 Somnath Temple
📍 Dwarkadhish Temple (Gomti nadi ke kinare)
📍 Swaminarayan Akshardham
📍 Galteshwar Temple
📍 Modhera Sun Temple
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: GUJ-RAAT = raat gujaarna. Somnath: Somvaar aa gaya, 'nath uth le', raat yahin nahi gujaarni → Somnath. Dwarka samudra ke neeche → samundar ka kinara Gujarat. Dwarkadhish → Gomti (gota maarke jaana padega → GOmti). Swaminarayan: Narayan = Krishna, Krishna = Dwarkadhish. Galteshwar: GALAT kaam raat ko → Gujarat. Modhera: 'Mo' = main bhi raat ko DHERI (dher) ho jaata hoon. ⚠️ Delhi me bhi Akshardham hai, par 'Swaminarayan Akshardham' Gujarat me hota hai (PYQ).

notes_list.title: 🛕 Karnataka ke Mandir
notes_list.basic_overview:
📍 Virupaksha Temple (Hampi, Ballari district)
📍 Vithala Temple (Hampi)
📍 Kollur Mookambika Temple
📍 Sharavan Belagola (Shravanabelagola)
📍 Chamundeshwari Temple
📍 Ladkhan Temple (Aihole)
📍 Navalinga Temple (Rashtrakuta)
📍 Hoysala Temples (UNESCO World Heritage, Sept 2023)
📍 Tibetan Buddhist Golden Temple (Bylakuppe)
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: KARNATAKA = NATAK. Viru (Sehwag) team select karte time pakshpaat ka natak nahi karta → Virupaksha. Collar upar karne ka natak → Kollur (collar) Mookambika, mukam tak nahi pahuncha. Sharavan = 'bal ka gola' hone ka natak. Chamunda = 'chhoo chhoo' natak. Vithala = khaali (thaali) baitha aadmi natak karta hai. Hoysala = HOLEsale: purana maal sasta bechne ka natak → UNESCO 2023. Lad = zyada LAAD → Aankh me HOLE (Aihole) → Ladkhan. Buddha ke paas sone ka mandir? Natak → Karnataka (Tibetan Golden Temple). Navalinga: direct yaad (Rashtrakuta).

notes_list.title: 🛕 Karnataka: Extra (PYQ options)
notes_list.basic_overview:
📍 Kadri Manjunath Temple – Shiv ke avtar ko samarpit (exam me Bengaluru wale option me yahi answer tha)
❌ Parameshwar mandir – Karnataka me nahi (PYQ option)
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Direct yaad kar lo, koi trick nahi. ⚠️ Note: Asli me Kadri Manjunath Mangaluru me hai; exam me options me ye hi sahi mana gaya tha.

notes_list.title: 🛕 Assam ke Mandir
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: ASAM = ASAMAAN. KAAM kisi ka bhi samaan nahi hota, 'asamaan' hota hai → Kamakhya (Kaam) → Assam. Sukreswar: 'Shukr hai Bhagwan ka sab asamaan banaya' → Assam.

notes_list.title: 🛕 Uttarakhand ke Mandir
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Uttara-KHAND = pahadon ke hisse (khand). Badri-NATH + Kedar-NATH = dono 'nath' pahadi dham. Direct yaad. (Swarn Mandir = Punjab, Amritsar.)

notes_list.title: 🛕 Tamil Nadu ke Mandir
notes_list.basic_overview:
📍 Meenakshi Temple (Madurai) – Pandya shasak
📍 Rameswaram Temple
📍 Brihadeeswara (Thanjavur) – Rajaraja Chola I
📍 Kamakshi Temple (Kanchipuram)
📍 Sri Ranganathaswamy (Srirangam)
📍 Airavateswara Temple
📍 Shore Temple (Mahabalipuram)
📍 Kapaleeswarar Temple – Bhagwan Shiv ko samarpit
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Master Trick: 'He Meenakshi, RAAM ki daya se ek baar tu mere se BAAHAR (Brihad) TU-MIL (Tamil), KAAM-KAAM ke saare RANG (Rang-nath) dikha doonga.' → Meenakshi, Rameswaram, Brihadeeswara, Tamilnadu, Kamakshi, Ranganathaswamy. Airavatesh: TANNA (tan ke) → 'tu mil to sahi, tanav dikhaunga'. Shore: 'tu mil to sahi, tera SHOR (awaaz) nikalwa dunga'. Kapaleeswarar: direct yaad, Shiv.

notes_list.title: 🛕 West Bengal ke Mandir
notes_list.basic_overview:
📍 Tarapith Temple
📍 Dakshineswar Kali Temple
📍 Kalighat Kali Temple
📍 Jangipur Hanuman Mandir
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: TAARA (sitara/Surya) pehle Poorv me, phir PEETH ki taraf Paschim me jaata hai → Tarapith = Paschim Bengal. Kaali (Kaala rang) → Bengal/Bihar side dhoop zyada → Dakshineswar + Kalighat Kali Mandir. Jangipur: JANG (lohe pe lagi) ka rang kaala → Bengal.

notes_list.title: 🛕 Rajasthan ke Mandir
notes_list.basic_overview:
📍 Dilwara Jain Temple (Mount Abu) – Chalukya shasak
📍 Karni Mata Temple (Deshnok) – chuhon ke liye prasiddh
📍 Govind Dev Ji Temple
📍 Shri Eklingji Temple
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Dilwara = dil me BAADA jise, usse RAJA ka sthaan deta ho → RAJasthan; wo CHAL ke aata hai → Chalukya. Karni = RAJA ke sthaan par baithe ho to maatao/bahno ke prati achchhe KARM karni padegi + unhe CHUHON se bachana → Karni Mata = chuhon wala mandir. Govind = Krishna (raja se bhi upar). Eklingji: EK-LINGji → KALING → raja ka sthaan.

notes_list.title: 🛕 Telangana ke Mandir
notes_list.basic_overview:
📍 Birla Mandir (Hyderabad)
📍 Bhadrakali Temple
📍 Kaleshwaram Mukteshwara Swamy Temple
📍 Chilkur Balaji Temple
📍 Yadagirigutta Temple
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: TEL-ANGANA = TEL lagana. BIRLA = BHIDLE (tel lagake bhidoge to grip nahi banegi). BhadraKALI: KALA tel koi nahi lagata. KALEshwar MUKTEshwar: kaale tel se mukti. CHILKUR: chhote chilkut bachche kaala tel laga lete hain. YADAgiri: unhe yaad nahi rehta (yaad se gir jaata hai) isliye.

notes_list.title: 🛕 Punjab: Swarn Mandir
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Swarn (sone) wala mandir = Punjab. Direct yaad.
